en-US.title: Auto Video Editor — Tenfold
en-US.subtitle: Bulk Edit & Silence Remover
en-US.description:
Film ten takes. Post ten videos.

Tenfold is an auto video editor for talking-to-camera clips. Import up to ten videos at once, pick the edits you want, and Tenfold edits every clip for you: silences cut, filler words gone, repeated takes removed, framed for vertical. One tap, a whole batch of finished videos.

BULK EDITING, DONE FOR YOU
• Edit 10 or more videos at the same time
• Silence remover: cuts dead air and long pauses to a natural beat
• Removes filler words ("um", "uh", "like") and repeated takes
• Pick the edits once for the whole batch, or change them for a single clip
• Reframes for 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9, with a subtle zoom at each cut

SAVE HOURS EVERY WEEK
• Skip trimming clips by hand: film today, post all week
• Check each video, then save the whole batch to Photos
• Ready for TikTok, Reels and Shorts

A REAL EDITOR WHEN YOU WANT ONE
• Trim, split, reorder and join clips on a timeline
• Word-by-word captions in your style
• Titles and hooks with a text tool: nine styles, drag, pinch and rotate
• Add music or a voiceover; music dips under speech automatically
• Undo, redo and revert to the original at any time

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything runs on your iPhone. No account, no upload, no waiting for a server. Your videos never leave your phone.

en-US.promoText: Film ten takes, get ten finished videos. Tenfold cuts the silences, pauses and filler words from every clip at once, right on your iPhone.

review.notes:
Tenfold has no accounts and no server for video processing. Everything runs on the device with Apple's on-device speech recognition (iOS 26). Videos, audio and transcripts never leave the device.

To test: open the app, finish onboarding, tap Import clips and pick one or more videos with speech from Photos, choose the edits to apply, then Generate. Open a finished video to reach the editor: Captions, Text, Audio and the + tile for adding clips. Export saves to Photos.

Subscriptions (sold through the App Store, presented with the Superwall SDK): Starter (monthly and yearly, no free trial), Pro and Studio (monthly and yearly, each with a 3-day free trial). The free plan works without any purchase (3 exports a month, batches of 10).

App Tracking Transparency: the tracking prompt appears on the first onboarding tap. Tracking is only used by AppsFlyer for ad attribution; the app works the same if tracking is declined. Anonymous usage analytics (PostHog) are not used for tracking.

Permissions are requested only when used: camera and microphone for in-app recording, add-to-Photos for export, speech recognition for captions.
